title: Decoupled Outer-Fixed 10-Layer Refinement
scientific_hypothesis: Fixing outer layer thicknesses to round-2 optimal values while reoptimizing inner layers with reduced learning rate will resolve finer spectral features near the 0.9977 ceiling without overshooting, potentially improving best_target_score by 0.0005-0.0015.
design_principle: Outer layers primarily control broadband edge antireflection; inner layers fine-tune dual-band interference matching. Decoupling these roles reduces optimization landscape complexity.
proposed_topology: 10 finite layers on Si substrate, alternating Ta2O5/SiO2 starting with Ta2O5 at air interface: Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Si
design_variables: outer layer thicknesses fixed to round-2 values
soft_objectives: minimize mean reflectance over 1260-1360 nm band
minimize mean reflectance over 1530-1565 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: outer layers fixed to proven values for process stability
theory_basis: Transfer matrix method thickness optimization for multilayer AR coatings
Decoupled optimization reduces parameter coupling in high-dimensional search spaces
expected_advantages: Preserves broadband edge performance from round-2
Focused optimization on inner layers may resolve dual-band interference features
Reduced learning rate prevents overshooting near performance ceiling
known_risks: Fixed outer layers may constrain global optimum
Inner layer reoptimization may not yield significant improvement if outer layers dominate performance
execution_request_english: Optimize a 10-layer Ta2O5/SiO2 anti-reflection coating on semi-infinite Si substrate at 0 deg unpolarized incidence. Layer sequence: Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2 (air to substrate). Fix outer layer thicknesses to round-2 optimal values: layer 0 (Ta2O5) = 79.09 nm, layer 1 (SiO2) = 105.74 nm, layer 8 (Ta2O5) = 82.51 nm, layer 9 (SiO2) = 99.77 nm. Reinitialize inner layers (indices 2-7) with plus or minus 15 nm uniform stochastic perturbation around round-2 values. Apply gradient_thickness optimizer with Adam algorithm, learning rate reduced by 30 percent from previous round, linear decay schedule. Minimize mean reflectance over wavelength bands 1260-1360 nm and 1530-1565 nm. All layer thicknesses bounded 20-400 nm. Report best_target_score, valid_candidates, tightest_margin, thicknesses_nm, and band-averaged reflectance/transmittance spectra. Canonical user controls: incidence angles 0 degrees. polarization unpolarized. wavelength intervals 1260-1360 nm, 1530-1565 nm. soft objectives: low average reflectance in 1260-1360 nm band; low average reflectance in 1530-1565 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high reflection in the specified bands. manufacturing constraints: maximum 12 layers; individual layer thickness between 20 nm and 400 nm; materials restricted to Ta2O5 and SiO2.
revision_reason: Implements feedback directive for round 3: decoupled initialization with fixed outer layers (indices 0,1,8,9) to preserve broadband edge antireflection, inner layers (indices 2-7) reinitialized with plus or minus 15 nm perturbation, Adam learning rate reduced 30 percent with linear decay to resolve finer spectral features near 0.9977 ceiling.
